provider reports 42 one-apiece buys pushed into a queue of trusted wallets seconds apart; apparent cohort participation is excluded by provider

learning: The first live forward observations after preregistration immediately produced exactly the attack class the provenance gate was designed to reject.
Raw shared-token overlap would have produced a false positive on both WATCH and FURN.
Wallet score and wallet count cannot override receipt/provenance evidence.
FURN also demonstrates that apparent convergence can coexist with effectively unusable liquidity.
These rows count as negative-control evidence for data-quality/provenance machinery, not as eligible convergence events toward the promotion minimum.
next: Continue forward observation until a self-initiated, entity-independent convergence event survives provenance.
Before any surviving event counts, complete economic-entity independence checks for participating cohort wallets.
Record rejected seeded/gift/dust cases as false-positive prevention evidence rather than deleting them.
